experienciasAcademicas.descricao: I worked on the foundation of the Salvador Junior Enterprise Core, leading communication and social media initiatives. I was responsible for planning and executing campaigns, managing ads, and creating institutional content, strengthening the core's digital presence.

I led marketing and customer relationship strategies, structuring sales funnels and communication campaigns. I developed leadership, negotiation, and teamwork skills, besides expanding networking and soft skills essential for the market.

I participated in the development of systems and institutional websites for real clients, applying PHP, MySQL, and Bootstrap. I contributed to delivering functional technological solutions suited to market needs.
I promoted advanced studies in structured programming and coding best practices. I acted as a member, guiding peers in resolving challenges and exchanging technical knowledge.

experienciasProfissionais.descricao: Full-stack development in PHP (Laravel), Vue.js, and Oracle, focusing on APIs and municipal financial systems. Highlights: Creation of the Audit Trail System, which increased auditor autonomy and reduced analysis time. Development and publication of the Commitment API, expanding fiscal transparency and enabling real-time integrations. Implementation of responsive and accessible interfaces following security and scalability best practices.

Maintenance and evolution of systems for public agencies using Laravel, Vue.js, and SQL Server. Assured availability and security of critical systems, such as Microsoft account management for PRODEB-BA. Developed the Accountability System for SEFAZ Camaçari, increasing precision and transparency in fiscal management. Configuration of environments with Docker and use of JWT authentication for secure, scalable applications.

Development of management systems and web/mobile interfaces with Vue.js, Quasar, and Laravel. Focus on usability, accessibility, and performance, improving user experience. PostgreSQL database modeling and implementation of SPAs with RESTful API integration.

experienciasOutras.descricao: Development of a virtual assistant with AI (Gemini), offering personalized interactions, quick replies, and automation of support processes. The project improved service efficiency and optimized response times.
Creation of an agricultural irrigation management platform, integrating climate and water quality data to optimize water resources usage and increase productivity.

Conceptualization of a modular ERP solution for small businesses, with REST APIs in .NET, Vue dashboards, and inventory and e-commerce management systems, allowing clients to choose only the required modules.
Support for events and entrepreneurship initiatives, along with the development of the institutional website using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.
